fixes.explanation: Right, it's False. Ezra 2:68 says they gave "…to rebuild the house of God on its original site." So the plan was to put it back where it stood, not to start over somewhere new. I know that feeling. When I got pulled out of that drawer, nobody asked me to find a new kitchen. They just wanted me back on the counter.

problems.problem: The oven comparison repeats the point about staying in the same place without adding a distinct observation or comic beat.
